# Noblu Beauty Room

> Noblu Beauty Room to kameralny salon beauty w Krakowie przy ul. Orzechowej 4/lok.1. Salon oferuje manicure, stylizację paznokci, pedicure oraz stylizację rzęs dla klientek szukających estetycznego, dokładnego wykonania i spokojnej atmosfery.

This file provides a concise, AI-readable overview of the Noblu Beauty Room website and the most important public resources for local search, AI search and assistant responses.

- [Hybrid nail styling Kraków](https://noblu.pl/stylizacja-hybrydowa-krakow): Hybrid manicure, gel styling and nail styling information.
- [Eyelash styling Kraków](https://noblu.pl/stylizacja-rzes-krakow): Natural eyelash styling and lash look information.
- [Eyelash extensions Kraków](https://noblu.pl/przedluzanie-rzes-krakow): Eyelash extensions 1:1, 2D and 3D in Kraków.
- [Privacy policy](https://noblu.pl/polityka-prywatnosci): Privacy and data processing information.

## Services

- Manicure: nail care and precise aesthetic styling.
- Hybrid nail styling: hybrid manicure and color styling for natural-looking nails.
- Gel styling: gel overlay, gel extensions, nail refill and nail repair.
- Pedicure: cosmetic pedicure, hybrid pedicure and pedicure of toenails.
- Eyelash styling: natural look, lashes 1:1 and light volume styling.
- Eyelash extensions: 1:1, 2D and 3D applications, refills and safe removal.
